αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.
βάζειν: βάζω — speak, chatter, prattle; pres. inf.: ’to babble, to talk’
βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc./fem. nom. sg.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε): ’rejoiced’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
δέμνι: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέμνι’ = δέμνια)
δέμνια: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; dat. sg.
δαίς: δαίς — feast, banquet (of shared portions); nom. sg.
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
δυσμενέων: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενῶν) · also adj. δυσμενής, -ές — hostile; masc. gen. pl. (ἀνδρῶν δυσμενέων ’of hostile men’)
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
δόμοισι: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (εἰν Ἀίδαο δόμοισι ’in the house of Hades’)
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δώματος: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. gen. sg., governed by the adv. εἴσω: ’within the house’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg.
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic form (unaccented after an accented word): ’I am’
εἰμὲν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν)
εἵματά: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. εἵματα: ’clothes’
εἶχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contracted from ἔ-εχε): ’held’
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg.
θεοείκελος: θεοείκελος — god-resembling, like a god; masc. nom. sg.
θερμὰ: θερμός — hot, warm; adj., neut. acc. pl. (agreeing with δάκρυα)
θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (θεῖον ποτόν ’divine drink’)
θηεῖτο: θηέομαι — gaze at, marvel at, behold; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was gazing in wonder’
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
καθύπερθε: καθύπερθε(ν) — above, from above; adv., + gen.: ’above’ (καθύπερθε Χίοιο ’above Chios’)
κακός: κακός — bad, base, poor; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’bad, poor’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl.
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial or cognate with a finite verb: οὐ καλὸν ἔειπες ’you have not spoken well’
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
κεῖνός: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’)
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
λάθρῃ: λάθρῃ — secretly, by stealth; adv. (dat. sg. used adverbially)
λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λίγειαν: λιγύς — clear-sounding, piercing, shrill; fem. acc. sg., epic accent (= λιγεῖαν)
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat.: ’should fight against’
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγαίρω: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge, be unwilling to allow; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I do not grudge [them] to’
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat. · also + acc., ’after, behind’ (μεθ’ ἡμιόνους ’behind the mules’)
μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, remembering’
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl.
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νοστήσας: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having returned’
νόσφι: νόσφι — apart from, except (+ gen.); adv./prep.
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
ξυνίει: ξυνίημι — perceive, understand, attend to (= συνίημι, ξυν- epic for συν-); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’attend!’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οἷα: οἷος — such as, of what kind; neut. acc. pl., relative: ’such (things) as’
οἷσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — his own, her own; possessive adj. (distinct from the relative ὅς); masc. dat. pl.: ’his own’ · also the relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (not the possessive): ’in whom’ (ἑταίρους ... οἷσι μάλιστα πεποίθεα)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj.
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέλει: πέλω — be, come to be, exist; pres. 3 sg. (= Attic ἐστί): ’there is’
πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
περιγιγνόμεθ: περιγίγνομαι — surpass, excel, be superior to (+ gen.); pres. 1 pl., elided (περιγιγνόμεθ’ = -μεθα)
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)

ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πὺξ: πύξ — with the fist, in boxing; adv. (grave accent mid-clause)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
σοῖς: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇ: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. sg.
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τέκεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεῦξε: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευξε)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’)
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg.
φίλοισιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις); also as a noun: ’friends’
φαιήκεσσιν: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -ξι)
φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg.
φορμίζων: φορμίζω — play the lyre (from φόρμιγξ); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φόρμιγγα: φόρμιγξ — lyre, the singer’s stringed instrument; fem. acc. sg.
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; mid. sense ’took firm hold of, clasped’; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist), tmesis with ἐν (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
χεῦεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (contrast augmented ἔχευε)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χορὸν: χορός — dance; dancing-place; masc. acc. sg.
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀέθλων: ἄεθλος — trial, labor, contest (Attic ἆθλος); gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἄθλων)
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀλκίνοος: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; nom. sg.
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνδράσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic ἀνδράσι
ἀνεβάλλετο: ἀναβάλλω — mid. strike up (a song); impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἀπεκαίνυτο: ἀποκαίνυμαι — surpass, outdo (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’outdid, excelled’
ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, worth (of a person); fem. gen. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’
ἄεθλοι: ἄεθλος — trial, contest, ordeal, labor; masc. nom. pl.
ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίσπῃ: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; aor. subj. 3 sg.
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐυκτίμενον: ἐυκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; neut. acc. sg.
ἐύξοον: ἐύξοος — well-polished, well-carved (ἐύ + ξέω); adj., masc. acc. sg. (δίφρον ἐύξοον ’a well-polished chariot’)
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
ἔθετ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔθετο → ἔθετ’)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔν: ἐν — in, on; preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ ’took firm hold’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg.
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἡμετέροισι: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
ἵσταντο: ἵστημι — set, place; mid. impf. 3 pl. (with ἀνά in tmesis): ’stood up, rose’
ὀίομαι: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, imagine; pres. 1 sg., uncontracted
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε) · also ὀνομάζω (simple, no preverb) — name, call by name, tell the name of; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’name (him)!’ (τρίτον ἄνδρ’ ὀνόμαζε)
ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.; neut. often adverbial: ’as much as’
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’)
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι) · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for those toward whom’ (ᾗσι τ’ ἐὺ φρονέῃσι ’for those toward whom she is well disposed’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
